evidence.excerpt: Lalić is scheduled to be on parental leave from October 2026 through approximately April 2027; project and consulting commitments starting before October 2026 can be accommodated. She prefers collaborations where her group handles material processing and characterisation rather than end-of-life assessment or life-cycle analysis, which is outside her current equipment and expertise. The twin-screw extruder has a maximum throughput of 5 kg/h in the current configuration, which limits pilot-scale ambitions without external facility access.
